"""Retain the whole terminal portable Sena four-check Nix validation."""
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
P = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
W = P.parent / 'friendly-hortative-sena'
OUT = W / 'docs/friendly-hortative-sena-portable-complete-nix-proof-archive.json'
assert not OUT.exists()
sha = lambda raw: hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
names = ['run_sena_portable_complete_nix_gate.py',
         'friendly-hortative-sena-portable-complete-nix-gate.json',
         'friendly-hortative-sena-portable-complete-nix-gate.log']
r = json.loads((P / names[1]).read_bytes())
assert r['state'] == 'passed' and r['phase'] == 'complete' and r['exit_code'] == 0
assert all(r[key] for key in ['inputs_unchanged', 'head_unchanged', 'index_unchanged', 'protected_binaries_unchanged',
                             'selected_preflight_passed', 'portable_selected_preflight_passed'])
assert r['head'] == '9a495ce9f175ca964dc3c9f2167bc2843c4f4ef4'
assert len(r['frozen_inputs']) == 8205 and len(r['inventory_source_files']) == 8163
assert len(r['results']) == 7 and all(row['exit_code'] == 0 for row in r['results'])
assert r['producer'] == dict(text=(P / names[0]).read_text(), sha256=sha((P / names[0]).read_bytes()))
assert r['log_sha256'] == sha((P / names[2]).read_bytes())
assert all(sha((W / name).read_bytes()) == digest for name, digest in r['frozen_inputs'].items())
assert [len(r['profiles'][name]['files']) for name in ['klem', 'corpus-adapter', 'web-assets']] == [1158, 1158, 18]
assert len(r['outputs']) == 4 and len(set(r['outputs'])) == 4
for index, value in enumerate(r['outputs']):
    path = Path(value)
    assert path.is_dir() if index < 3 else path.is_file() and path.stat().st_size == 0
files = {}
destination = W / 'docs/friendly-hortative-sena-portable-complete-nix-proof'
destination.mkdir()
for name in names:
    raw = (P / name).read_bytes(); packed = gzip.compress(raw, mtime=0)
    path = destination / (name + '.gz'); path.write_bytes(packed)
    assert gzip.decompress(path.read_bytes()) == raw
    files[name] = dict(path=str(path.relative_to(W / 'docs')), source_sha256=sha(raw), archive_sha256=sha(packed), bytes=len(raw))
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(dict(state='actual-portable-Sena-four-Nix-checks-passed', files=files,
                              head=r['head'], tracked_source_files=8205, selected_source_files=8163,
                              revision_controls=31, portable_installed_controls=46,
                              compile_profile_files={'klem':1158, 'corpus-adapter':1158, 'web-assets':18},
                              complete_source_head_index_and_six_binaries_unchanged=True,
                              expected_output_types=['directory','directory','directory','empty-file'],
                              producer=dict(text=Path(__file__).read_text(), sha256=sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes())),
                              scope='Actual named Sena checkpoint; shared25 promotion, main integration, quiet timing and contextual/independent review remain separate.'), indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(files=len(files), manifest_sha256=sha(OUT.read_bytes()))))
